an4.72:1.1: bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni c' assa āraddhā hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya. Katamehi catuhi? Nekkhamma-vitakkena, avyāpāda-vitakkena, avihiṃsāvitakkena, sammādiṭṭhiyā. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu apaṇṇakataṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yoni c' assa āraddho hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyāti. Catuhi
